verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to run evals in a CI pipeline and no way to block deployments based on eval results. Mirrors does preview corrections against stored traces before activating them and compares outcomes against holdout groups in production, but those are adjacent controls, not CI eval gating. Its llms.txt also presents evals as a separate category that it fits alongside (Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust).
